notes: Item 19 discloses gross sales for three cohorts: all franchised outlets, top 20%, and bottom 20% by performance. Gross sales defined as total revenue from goods and services less sales tax, discounts, allowances, and returns. Data sourced from franchisee-reported sales; not audited.
